notablePrerequisites: Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and Scorched Ruins.
Repeat from step 2.
